purpose: Add fresh measured-only train and validation sites without changing existing sites or the sealed population.
source_population: Existing non-sealed site geometries in docs/experiments/matrix-r3-sites.json; no outcome data are used.

core_matrix.layout_transform: mulberry32(site_seed) draws XY translation over [-5,5] metres; translate all node/source/building centres together; preserve relative geometry, source counts, Z coordinates, building sizes, and matrix settings.

density_sweep.layout_transform: same seeded common translation as core sites.

sealed_set.action: Do not modify, run, or regenerate.
